# TrendSpider "QLD Claude AI Scalper" on US100 / US30 / S&P 500 / Gold: raw results (generated by analyse.py)

M30, long only, native MT5 Model 4 (real ticks from 2026-01, generated before), $100,000 per asset, 1x notional (position = equity), 150 ms, recorded commission + swap. Indices trade the New York regular session; gold every bar. Rules in RULES.md.

Metrics: consistency = % of calendar months with a profit; Sharpe = annualised daily closed P&L; balance DD = closed-trade drawdown; equity DD = MT5 report (full run only); trades/day over weekdays.
